title: Release pantheon-base v0.10.1 and hand off to Pantheon Ops
goal: Close release-governance debt, make CI aggregation fail closed, publish an immutable v0.10.1 foundation release, and provide a verified consumer handoff.

in: Fail closed CI Summary for required jobs while retaining full-repo Go Lint as an advisory result; new-code lint remains blocking in quality.yml
Normalize the historical Sonar Go task manifest and restore its missing evidence linkage
Close stale hosted-check and review ledgers with verifiable GitHub evidence
Track the OpenSpec skeleton and update release changelog
Create, verify, publish, and merge pantheon-base-v0.10.1
Publish the release artifact and handoff metadata for a separate Pantheon Ops L2 consumer upgrade
out: Base product features or runtime behavior changes
Database, permission, menu, i18n, API, or UI changes
Any Pantheon Ops worktree modification; the consumer upgrade has its own L2 task and evidence
Manual copying of Base main into Pantheon Ops
Publishing from an unverified or mutable candidate

assumptionsAndOpenQuestions: The next semantic version is v0.10.1 because the payload is a backward-compatible governance and release patch.
The maintainer explicitly authorized commit, PR merge, branch cleanup, GitHub release publication, and the downstream Ops upgrade.
minimumViableApproach: Reuse the existing release scripts, PR wrapper, Release Gate, and Ops foundation consumer. Add no dependency and change no product code.
successCriteria: All Base local governance, workflow, release-tooling, and formatting checks pass
Two independent reviewers report no blocking finding
The exact candidate SHA passes required GitHub checks and Release Gate
The v0.10.1 tag and GitHub Release assets bind to the manifest commit
Base local and remote branch sets contain only main after merge
The published release exposes the manifest, checksum, compatibility metadata, and handoff needed by the separate Pantheon Ops L2 upgrade

affectedSubgraph: CI required jobs -> CI Summary -> Release Gate candidate checks
task manifest -> evidence -> review -> PR governance
candidate commit -> foundation manifest -> bundle -> GitHub Release -> Ops lock

requiredSensors: GitHub required checks and Release Gate on the candidate SHA
humanGate: Satisfied by the maintainer request on 2026-08-05 authorizing publication and downstream consumption.
syncExpectation: After publication, a separate Pantheon Ops L2 task must dry-run and consume the release with compatibility, rollback, and runtime verification; no manual Base main copy is allowed.
